title: NSX Manager update manifest
description: Published as the release asset update.json. The client fetches it from releases/latest/download/update.json. See docs/reference/update-manifest.md and ADR-0005.

schema_version.description: Contract version. A client refuses anything greater than it understands and tells the user to update manually, rather than guessing.

product.description: Guards against a manifest from a different product being served by mistake.

tag.description: The git tag. Must equal 'v' + version.

published_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC. Displayed as 'released N days ago'.

channel.description: Clients on the stable channel ignore a beta manifest.

mandatory.description: When true the client blocks the main menu until the user updates. Making this a per-release publisher decision replaces the predecessor's unconditional lockout at main_frame.cpp:94-133, which hid all ten tabs whenever any newer tag existed.

min_supported.description: Oldest installed version that may update in-app. If installed < min_supported the client refuses the in-app path and directs the user to the zip, which covers breaking SD-layout changes.

min_atmosphere.description: Minimum Atmosphere version. The client warns rather than refusing - it cannot always detect this reliably.

assets.description: At least one asset of kind app-nro is required, or the updater has nothing to download.

name.description: A BARE filename. No slashes, no backslashes, no '..', no leading dot - a name that can traverse directories must never reach a filesystem call.

kind.description: What the client selects by. It never parses a filename to decide what something is. An unknown kind is skipped, not an error - that is the forward-compatibility escape hatch.

url.description: https only, and must be a GitHub release asset.

size.description: Bytes. Used for the free-space pre-flight and as a cheap truncation check before hashing.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex. An asset without a verifiable digest must never be downloadable.
